svg.metadata: Taiwan Atlas 2021.9.20 / MOI NLSC; World: Natural Earth Admin 0 Countries 5.1.1 (1:50 million); optional Admin 1 boundary lines 5.1.0 and labels 5.1.1 (1:10 million, Public Domain), accessed 2026-10-20; Terrain Tiles: Mapzen, USGS SRTM & GMTED2010, DOC/NOAA/NESDIS/NCEI. Accessed 2026-10-19. Basemap coverage: 85 S to 85 N; hatched polar areas lie outside coverage. Dataset cut edges are not coastlines. Hypsometric tint and hillshade modified in browser. Water: continuous ocean bathymetry from Mapzen/AWS Terrain Tiles (ETOPO1, DOC/NOAA/NESDIS/NCEI), accessed 2026-10-21; pixel elevations mapped through an interpolated 0–11000 m blue palette. Tile zoom and image interpolation do not add measurement accuracy. Ocean mask follows the active land/coastline geometry. Optional generalized contours: Natural Earth bathymetry 4.1.0 (SRTM Plus); rivers/lakes 5.0.0; Public Domain, original scale 1:10,000,000. Lakes use a uniform cartographic blue; lake depth is not represented. Not for navigation. https://github.com/tilezen/joerd/blob/master/docs/data-sources.mdProjection: Web Mercator (EPSG:3857); WGS84 geographic input.; Demo data: undefined; coordinates merged to undefined decimal places; mode=undefined; markerShapes={}; legendEdits={}; displayNames={}.
